summary: Website for True Origin Company LLP (TrueOrigin Exports), a professional agricultural export company. The site now uses updated copy: Hero headline 'Premium Agricultural Exports From India to Global Markets', subheadline emphasizing compliance and logistics, and two CTA buttons ('Request Product Specifications', 'Contact Sales'). About section updated to professional exporter copy with Vision and Mission statements. Products section includes Moringa Leaves & Powder, Curry Leaves, Fresh Vegetables, and Custom Agri Sourcing. A Quality & Compliance section highlights documentation (COA, lab reports, phytosanitary certs, etc.). Product page structure updated with detailed Moringa Leaf Powder specs for export-grade buyers. Color palette confirmed: Deep Emerald (#0F3D2E), Soft Gold (#C6A75E), Background (#F4F1EA), Text (#1A1A1A). Fonts: Playfair Display or Libre Baskerville for headings, Poppins or Lato for body. Contact emails: info@trueoriginexports.com and sales@trueoriginexports.com. Phone: 9773303026. Website: www.trueoriginintl.com. Social media links (Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, Facebook) to be added later. SSL to be enabled.

existing_features.title: Create a multi-section landing page for True Origin Company LLP, including: a hero section with company name and tagline, an 'About Us' section describing the business (dealing in perishable and non-perishable food products), a 'Products' section showcasing key offerings, and a 'Contact' section with placeholder contact details.

Render the generated images (moringa-powder.png, moringa-leaf.png, farm.png, hero-bg.png) as static assets from frontend/public/assets/generated. Use the farm image as the hero background, moringa powder and moringa leaf images in the Products section, and the hero-bg as a decorative or supplemental background element.

Apply a cohesive earthy-green and warm-cream visual theme throughout the website. Use natural, organic-feeling typography (e.g., a serif display font for headings paired with a clean sans-serif for body text). The layout should feel clean, trustworthy, and premium — appropriate for a natural food products brand. Apply this theme consistently across all sections, cards, buttons, and the navigation bar.
Remove the 'Moringa Tablet' product card from the Products section entirely.
Remove the 'Moringa Seed Oil' product card from the Products section.
Remove any 'years of experience' stat or claim from the About section (or anywhere else on the page). The company has just started, so no experience duration should be displayed.
Update the Contact section with the real company contact details: phone number 9773303026 and email trueorigin@gmail.com. Replace any placeholder values.

Add a dedicated 'Social Media' section (or clearly marked subsection) to the page as a placeholder for social media videos. The section should display a visually styled empty state with a heading such as 'Follow Us' or 'Our Latest Updates', placeholder video embed slots (e.g., 2–3 placeholder cards with a play icon and label), and a note that links are coming soon. Include empty/disabled icon slots for Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, and Facebook so URLs can be wired up in a future update.

Add an 'Export & Cargo' visual section (or subsection within About/Products) that features the generated export and cargo images to communicate that True Origin Company LLP is a professional exporter. The section should include a short heading such as 'Global Exports' and brief supporting copy about the company's export capabilities.

Add the uploaded True Origin Exports logo (to be saved as frontend/public/assets/generated/logo.png) to the navigation bar. Display it on the left side of the nav, replacing or accompanying the current text-based brand name. The logo should be appropriately sized for a navigation bar (height ~40–48px) and must be visible against the nav background on both scroll states (transparent and solid).

Create a language selection context/provider that stores the user's chosen language and exposes a translation function. Support at least English, Hindi, and one additional regionally relevant language (e.g., Marathi or Gujarati). All translatable strings across the site must be defined in a centralized translations file keyed by language code. The company name 'True Origin Company LLP' must never be translated and must remain in English in all language modes.

Add a language selector UI control to the right-hand side of the navigation bar. The control should display the currently selected language (e.g., 'EN', 'HI') and open a dropdown listing the available languages. Selecting a language immediately applies the translation site-wide. The control must be visible and functional in both the transparent (top of page) and solid (scrolled) nav states, and must also be accessible in the mobile nav menu.

Translate all user-facing text in every section and component — HeroSection, AboutSection, ProductsSection, ExportCargoSection, SocialMediaSection, ContactSection, Footer, and nav links — using the centralized translations system. Each component must consume the language context to render its strings. Static image alt text should also be translated where applicable.

Add the company website URL 'www.trueoriginintl.com' as a clickable hyperlink (href='https://www.trueoriginintl.com') in the Footer component alongside the existing contact details (phone and email). Also display it in the ContactSection's contact info panel. The URL must be translated as a label (e.g., 'Website:') using the centralized translations system for English, Hindi, and Marathi, while the URL value itself remains unchanged across all languages.

Add three new farm/product images — moringa farm, curry leaves farm, and okra farm — as static assets at frontend/public/assets/generated/ (filenames: moringa-farm.png, curry-leaves-farm.png, okra-farm.png). Display these images on the website, either within the Products section as contextual farm imagery for the respective products or in a dedicated 'Our Farms' visual subsection. All image alt text must use the centralized translations system.

Update the ContactSection component and Footer component to replace the existing email address(es) with two email addresses: info@trueoriginexports.com and sales@trueoriginexports.com. Both emails must be displayed as clickable mailto: links. The email label and these two addresses must also be added to the centralized translations file for English, Hindi, and Marathi (the address values themselves must remain unchanged across languages).

Create a Privacy Policy page as a new React route/component (e.g., /privacy-policy). The page must follow the existing earthy-green and warm-cream visual theme, include the site navigation bar and footer, and contain comprehensive privacy policy content covering: data collection practices, use of personal information, cookies policy, third-party services, user rights, contact information for privacy inquiries (info@trueoriginexports.com), and the effective date. All user-facing text must be integrated with the centralized translations system for English, Hindi, and Marathi. Add a link to the Privacy Policy page in the footer.

Create a Terms and Conditions page as a new React route/component (e.g., /terms-and-conditions). The page must follow the existing earthy-green and warm-cream visual theme, include the site navigation bar and footer, and contain comprehensive terms and conditions content covering: acceptance of terms, use of the website, intellectual property, product information disclaimer, limitation of liability, governing law, dispute resolution, and contact information (info@trueoriginexports.com). All user-facing text must be integrated with the centralized translations system for English, Hindi, and Marathi. Add a link to the Terms and Conditions page in the footer.

Create an Export Certification, Quality Control & Product Specifications page as a new React route/component (e.g., /export-certification). The page must follow the existing earthy-green and warm-cream visual theme, include the site navigation bar and footer, and contain detailed content organized into three sections: (1) Export Certifications — covering types of certifications obtained or pursued (e.g., APEDA, FSSAI, Phytosanitary Certificate, Certificate of Origin, HACCP), their purpose, and how they assure buyers; (2) Quality Control — covering sourcing standards, inspection processes, packaging and storage protocols, and traceability; (3) Product Specifications — detailed spec tables or cards for each product (Moringa Powder, Moringa Leaf/Dried, Curry Leaves, Okra/Lady Finger) including scientific name, form, color, moisture content, packaging options, shelf life, and available grades. All user-facing text must be integrated with the centralized translations system for English, Hindi, and Marathi. Add a link to this page in the footer and optionally in the navigation bar.

Set up client-side routing (e.g., using React Router) in the application to support the new pages: Privacy Policy (/privacy-policy), Terms and Conditions (/terms-and-conditions), and Export Certification (/export-certification). The main landing page must remain the default route (/). The navigation bar and footer links to these pages must use the router's Link component for in-app navigation without full page reloads.

In the mobile hamburger menu (NavBar), add a 'Product Specifications' nav link positioned immediately after the existing 'Products' nav item. This link should navigate to the /export-certification route (scrolling to or highlighting the Product Specifications section of that page), or navigate directly to /export-certification if a dedicated product-specifications anchor is not available.

In the mobile hamburger menu (NavBar), add a 'Privacy Policy' nav link positioned immediately before the 'Contact Us' nav item. This link should navigate to the /privacy-policy route using the router's Link component.

In the mobile hamburger menu (NavBar), add an 'Export Certification' (or 'Certification') nav link positioned immediately after the 'Product Specifications' nav item. This link should navigate to the /export-certification route using the router's Link component.

Fix the navigation bar logo so that it does not change color, format, or appearance when the user scrolls down. The logo image (logo.png) must render identically in both the transparent (top-of-page) and solid (scrolled) navbar states — no white filter, brightness, or invert CSS effects should be applied to the logo element based on scroll state. Remove any conditional styling (e.g., filter, brightness, invert, or color class toggling) that is currently applied to the logo img element in response to the navbar's scroll state.

In the HeroSection component, locate and remove the spurious small rectangular white box element that appears above the tagline text 'Premium natural food products from the heart of India to the world'. Inspect the JSX and CSS for any empty div, span, pseudo-element (::before / ::after), or wrapper element with a white background, border, or box-shadow that is rendering as a visible white rectangle in that area, and eliminate it so no such artifact is visible.

Locate and remove the visible block of static text displaying '+91 97733 03026', 'info@trueoriginexports.com', 'sales@trueoriginexports.com', and 'www.trueoriginintl.com' that is rendering as plain visible text somewhere on the website (likely in HeroSection, a layout wrapper, or App.tsx). This text must be fully removed from the JSX/HTML so it no longer appears on screen. The actual contact details in the ContactSection info panel and Footer must remain intact.

Perform a thorough audit of the HeroSection component and all related CSS/Tailwind classes to locate and eliminate any remaining small rectangular white box artifact visible in or around the hero area. Inspect all div, span, section, and pseudo-element (::before / ::after) nodes for any white, off-white, or light-colored background, border, box-shadow, or outline that could be rendering as a visible white rectangle. Remove or correct all such elements so no white box artifact is visible anywhere in the hero section at any viewport size.

Update the HeroSection component with the new headline 'Premium Agricultural Exports From India to Global Markets', subheadline 'TrueOrigin Exports delivers high-quality, responsibly sourced natural food products with complete compliance, transparency, and reliable international logistics support.', and two CTA buttons: 'Request Product Specifications' (linking to /export-certification) and 'Contact Sales' (linking to the #contact section). All strings must be added to the centralized translations file for English, Hindi, and Marathi.

Update the AboutSection component with the professional exporter copy: heading 'Trusted Indian Export Partner', body paragraph describing TrueOrigin Exports as a professionally managed export company committed to supplying premium agricultural products to international buyers focusing on quality control, lab-tested products, export documentation accuracy, and long-term trade relationships. Include three checklist items: '✔ Quality Assured', '✔ Export Documentation Ready', '✔ Global Shipping Support'. Add Vision statement ('To become a globally trusted supplier of premium Indian agricultural products.') and Mission statement ('To deliver safe, high-quality, and compliant products while creating long-term value for our international partners.'). All strings must be added to the centralized translations file for English, Hindi, and Marathi.

Update the ProductsSection component with a new product list under heading 'Our Export Products': Moringa Leaves & Powder, Curry Leaves, Fresh Vegetables, and Custom Agri Sourcing. Add a supporting line 'Each product is processed, tested, and packed according to international export standards.' Add a 'View Product Specifications' button that navigates to /export-certification. Remove any product cards not in this list (e.g., Okra/Lady Finger standalone card if present as a separate item inconsistent with the new list). All strings must be added to the centralized translations file for English, Hindi, and Marathi.

Add a new 'Quality & Compliance' section to the homepage between the Products section and the existing ExportCargoSection (or in a logical position after Products). The section heading must be 'International Quality Standards'. It must list six documentation items: Certificate of Analysis (COA), Microbial Test Reports, Heavy Metal Analysis, Pesticide Residue Testing, Organic Certification (if applicable), and Phytosanitary Certification. Include supporting copy: 'Our commitment to compliance ensures smooth customs clearance and buyer confidence.' End the section with a full-width CTA button 'Get a Quote Within 24 Hours' that links to the #contact section. Style the section using the existing Deep Emerald (#0F3D2E) / Soft Gold (#C6A75E) / cream palette. All strings must be added to the centralized translations file for English, Hindi, and Marathi.

Update the ExportCertificationPage component's Product Specifications section to include a detailed spec card for 'Moringa Leaf Powder – Export Grade' with the following fields: Botanical Name: Moringa Oleifera, Form: Fine Powder, Color: Natural Green, Odor: Characteristic, Moisture: < 7%, Mesh Size: 80–100 mesh, Microbial Limits: As per international standards, Heavy Metals: Within permissible limits, Pesticide Residue: As per EU/USFDA norms, Shelf Life: 24 months, Storage Condition: Store in cool, dry place. Include Packaging Options: 1 kg / 5 kg / 25 kg, food-grade inner lining, export-ready cartons. Include Documentation Provided: COA, Lab Test Report, Phytosanitary Certificate, Invoice & Packing List. Add a 'Request Specification Sheet' CTA button that links to the #contact section or mailto:sales@trueoriginexports.com. All new strings must be added to the centralized translations file for English, Hindi, and Marathi.

Confirm and enforce the color palette and typography site-wide. Primary color must be #0F3D2E (Deep Emerald), Accent #C6A75E (Soft Gold), Background Light #F4F1EA, Text Dark #1A1A1A, White #FFFFFF. Headings must use Playfair Display or Libre Baskerville (serif). Body text must use Poppins or Lato (sans-serif). Audit all components (HeroSection, AboutSection, ProductsSection, Quality & Compliance section, ExportCargoSection, SocialMediaSection, ContactSection, Footer, NavBar, ExportCertificationPage, PrivacyPolicyPage, TermsAndConditionsPage) to ensure consistent application of these tokens. Update tailwind.config.js and index.css if needed to reflect these exact hex values as CSS custom properties.

In the ExportCertificationPage component, fix the Product Specifications section so that all spec fields, values, packaging options, and documentation items render as properly formatted, human-readable text instead of raw technical strings (e.g., escaped characters, raw JSON, template literal artifacts, or unstyled plain text). The spec card for 'Moringa Leaf Powder – Export Grade' and any other product spec cards must display their content using the existing styled card/table layout. Do not change any other section, component, or file.

In the NavBar component, locate the 'Get In Touch' / 'Contact Us' navigation link that is currently rendering as raw technical text (e.g., a translation key string, escaped characters, or template literal artifact) and fix it so it renders as the correct human-readable label using the centralized translations system. The nav link must display properly in both the desktop nav and the mobile hamburger menu, and in all three language modes (English, Hindi, Marathi).

In the NavBar component, fix the mobile hamburger menu dropdown so that its background is always solid white (#FFFFFF) regardless of the user's scroll position on the underlying page. The dropdown panel must not be transparent, semi-transparent, or inherit the page scroll state. This must remain consistent: even if the user scrolls the background content while the mobile menu is open, the dropdown background stays solid white.

In the mobile hamburger menu (NavBar), add an 'About Us' nav link positioned immediately after the existing 'About' nav item. This link should navigate to the #about anchor section on the main landing page using smooth scrolling or the router's navigation mechanism. The label must use the centralized translations system for English, Hindi, and Marathi.

In the PrivacyPolicyPage component, fix all content sections so that they render as properly formatted, human-readable text. Locate all translation keys consumed by the component in the centralized translations file and ensure their values are plain readable prose (not raw JSON, escaped characters, template literal artifacts, or untranslated key strings). Every section heading, paragraph, list item, and label must display as normal readable text in English, Hindi, and Marathi.

In the mobile hamburger menu (NavBar), fix the 'Product Specifications' nav link so that it navigates to a dedicated product specifications view — either the Product Specifications section within the /export-certification page (using an anchor such as #product-specifications), or a clearly scoped product specs route — rather than landing on the Export Certification details (certifications/quality control) section. The link must scroll to or highlight the Product Specifications section specifically.
